import contextlib
import io
import json
import re
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlencode, urlsplit
from unittest.mock import patch
from hollerau.analytical import chatgpt_login as login

class Completed(Exception):
    pass

@contextlib.contextmanager
def store():
    yield {'host_id': 'urn:uuid:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'profiles': {}, 'active': None}

checks = []
class IsolatedServer:
    def __init__(self, address, handler):
        self.handler = handler
        self.server_port = 50434
    def __enter__(self):
        return self
    def __exit__(self, *args):
        pass
    def request(self, method, path, headers=None, fields=None):
        handler = object.__new__(self.handler)
        body = urlencode(fields or {}).encode()
        handler.path = path
        handler.headers = {'Host': '127.0.0.1:50434', 'Content-Length': str(len(body)), **(headers or {})}
        handler.rfile = io.BytesIO(body)
        handler.wfile = io.BytesIO()
        result = {'headers': {}}
        handler.send_response = lambda value: result.update(status=value)
        handler.send_header = lambda key, value: result['headers'].update({key: value})
        handler.end_headers = lambda: None
        getattr(handler, 'do_' + method)()
        result['body'] = handler.wfile.getvalue().decode()
        return result
    def handle_request(self):
        page = self.request('GET', '/')
        assert page['status'] == 200
        assert page['headers']['Referrer-Policy'] == 'strict-origin'
        token = re.search(r'name="csrf" value="([^"]+)"', page['body']).group(1)
        valid = {'csrf': token, 'profile': ''}
        result = self.request('POST', '/auth/start', {'Origin': 'http://127.0.0.1:50434'}, valid)
        assert result['status'] == 303
        target = urlsplit(result['headers']['Location'])
        assert target.scheme == 'https' and target.netloc == 'auth.openai.com'
        params = parse_qs(target.query)
        assert params['client_id'] == ['dynamic_agent_client']
        assert params['redirect_uri'] == ['http://127.0.0.1:50434/auth/callback']
        assert params['code_challenge_method'] == ['S256']
        checks.append('fresh form reaches official authorization redirect')
        for origin in ['null', 'https://unrelated.example']:
            denied = self.request('POST', '/auth/start', {'Origin': origin}, valid)
            assert denied['status'] == 403 and 'Location' not in denied['headers']
        checks.append('opaque and foreign origins are rejected')
        for fields in [{'csrf': 'stale', 'profile': ''}, {'csrf': [token, token]}, {'csrf': 'é'}]:
            denied = self.request('POST', '/auth/start', {'Origin': 'http://127.0.0.1:50434'}, fields)
            assert denied['status'] == 400 and 'Location' not in denied['headers']
            assert 'Open a fresh connection page' in denied['body']
        checks.append('stale, duplicate and malformed form tokens are rejected')
        back = self.request('GET', '/auth/start')
        assert back['status'] == 303 and back['headers']['Location'] == '/'
        checks.append('refresh returns to fresh form')
        denied = self.request('GET', '/auth/callback?state=incorrect&code=must-not-log-this')
        assert denied['status'] == 400
        checks.append('invalid callback is rejected')
        raise Completed()

capture = io.StringIO()
config = {'authorization_endpoint': 'https://auth.openai.com/api/accounts/authorize'}
with patch.object(login, 'HTTPServer', IsolatedServer), patch.object(login, 'locked_store', store), \
     patch.object(login, 'discovery', return_value=config), patch.object(login.httpx, 'Client'), \
     contextlib.redirect_stdout(capture):
    try:
        login.sign_in(open_browser=False)
    except Completed:
        pass
assert 'must-not-log-this' not in capture.getvalue()
events = [json.loads(line).get('sign_in_event') for line in capture.getvalue().splitlines()]
assert 'authorization_redirect_sent' in events and 'invalid_callback' in events
print(json.dumps({'isolated_auth_checks': checks, 'network_requests': 0, 'model_requests': 0}))
